Miscellaneous
a
Entire Agreement

This Agreement, including its appended Exhibits and Purchase Schedules entered into during the Term, constitutes the entire agreement between the Parties with respect to the sale of products by Seller to Buyer and the purchase of products by Buyer from Seller

This Agreement supersedes all prior and simultaneous representations, discussions, negotiations, letters, proposals, agreements and understandings, whether written or oral, with respect to this subject matter
This Agreement will not be binding on either Party unless and until signed by the chief executive officers of each Party
No handwritten or other addition, deletion or other modification to the printed portions of this Agreement will be binding upon either Party to this Agreement
b
Amendments

A Party may not amend nor supplement the terms and conditions in this Agreement through the inclusion of additional or different terms and conditions in any quotation, purchase order, invoice, bill of lading, letter, email or other document or communication
This Section does not prevent the reliance on the descriptive information in transaction documents identifying the ordered Products (e

contract_agreement_summary: Master Supply Agreement between REYNOLDS CONSUMER PRODUCTS LLC (Seller) and PACTIV LLC (Buyer) for the sale and purchase of products.
Agreement includes appended Exhibits and Purchase Schedules.
The agreement constitutes the entire understanding between the parties, superseding all prior agreements.
Amendments to the agreement must be in writing and signed by the chief executive officers of both parties.
compliance_and_expectations_summary: The Indemnifying Party must provide information and cooperation reasonably requested by the Indemnified Party in the investigation, defense, settlement, and satisfaction of any Indemnified Claim.
The Indemnifying Party will reimburse the Indemnified Party for reasonable, actual, substantiated out-of-pocket expenses incurred in providing requested information or cooperation.
The Indemnifying Party must act in good faith in exercising control over the investigation, defense, settlement, and satisfaction of the Indemnified Claim.
Seller will provide products to buyer as per the agreement.
Buyer will purchase products from seller as per the agreement.

amount_deliverables_for_shipments.description: Supply of consumer goods from Reynolds Consumer Products to PACTIV LLC based on purchase orders and schedules.

termination_and_expiry_summary: The agreement does not explicitly mention termination or expiry conditions in the provided context.
It is implied that the agreement continues unless amended or superseded by a new agreement.
